family.description: Exploratory pilot of issue 63bad95d, protocol version 4: this addendum is the pilot and every cell is exploratory. Question: is the native build of the profile no worse than its portable build on one primary workload per entry-point group? The baseline arm is the tuned-portable build: default target, simd and tuning-profile features, --cfg gf2_tuning_baked, the measured core owner the plan pins installed before the first selector read. The candidate arm is the native build: the same sources, features, cfg and installed owner with -C target-cpu=native added. The two arms are separate executables of one harness crate and differ in that one flag. Kernel-isolated cells time the public kernel entry on prepared operands; whole-consumer cells time the public BitMatrix call including its output allocation and release. Every cell is warm, single-core and calibrated. The family selects nothing: it reports whether a consumer who builds for the host loses anything against the portable profile build. This family repeats 63bad95d-native-ladder, by invoker ruling, on a quiet host with the same cells, arms and settings on its own ledger: the campaigns of 63bad95d-native-ladder run on a loaded host, at the launcher and session load averages dev/active/1a379447-zen3-cpu-performance/63bad95d/disturbance-record.md states under 'Host load each campaign records', and their receipts stay committed as measured.

effect.rationale: Five percent of a kernel call is the smallest change a consumer dominated by these calls would act on. The confirmation refreezes the margin strictly above one plus the pilot-derived resolution.
effect.equivalence_rationale: Within five percent the two builds are interchangeable for a consumer. The confirmation refreezes the margin strictly above one plus the pilot-derived resolution.
effect.material_gap_rationale: The family holds no comparator-gap cell and declares no external gap.

complexity_budget.maintenance_rationale: Zero added production lines and zero unsafe kernels: the family measures build configurations of committed sources, and its outcome is the value of existing baked constants.
